Data for a given candle will be considered finalized once the next candle appears on the specified graph. The last trading day of a given week will be considered finalized once the market closes on that day, typically at 5 PM ET on Friday.

This market’s resolution will be based solely on information from the “H” figure located at the top of the EUR/USD Streaming Chart on Investing.com for the specified currency pair (e.g., https://www.investing.com/currencies/eur-usd-chart).

eventMetadata.context_description: The primary driver of EUR/USD sentiment remains the Fed-ECB policy rate differential, currently near 125-140 basis points favoring the dollar with the Fed funds target at 3.50-3.75% and the ECB deposit rate at 2.25%. Hawkish remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole have lifted September hike odds for the Fed, while persistent Eurozone inflation pressures—evident in recent French and Spanish data—have increased market pricing for an ECB move higher. This dynamic has contributed to the pair's recent pullback toward 1.158 from August highs near 1.17. Traders are watching September central bank meetings and upcoming U.S. jobs and CPI releases for signals on whether the spread narrows or widens through year-end.
